text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 429 anomaly: tenant="citrine" in VPC pool="vpc-eu-west-1". 15m moving avg 429 rate increased to 18%. Potential customer-visible failures. Automatically opened thread. Paging on-call.

alex_oncall: Got the page. I'm oncall for this rotation — will triage. @maria_prod_eng @kevin_network can you join?

maria_prod_eng: joining. any customer notes from sales? @sam_sales_eng?

sam_sales_eng: Hi — Citrine's SRE already DMed our AE. They're seeing a spike from a batch job hitting rate limits; business says it started ~8m ago and they're seeing ~10% failed requests on their end. They asked for an emergency temp increase if possible.

kevin_network: looking at routing and quota shards. Early glance: this tenant is currently on a shared VPC pool with conservative leaky-bucket config (burst token=500, sustained=120 qps). We're seeing sustained bursts from a few IPs from their subnets.

alex_oncall: Do we have isolation options quick? Options: 1) Emergency quota tether (temp override on their tenant) 2) Move them to reserved slice in the same pool 3) Divert degraded model/slow-path. Which is fastest?

maria_prod_eng: Option 1 is fastest. We have a runbook: "emergency-rate-tether" that issues a short-lived override via control-plane admin CLI. I'll run it if we agree values. Need approval for contract override (sales/legal) for billing impact but we can attach note.

sam_sales_eng: I can approve short 30m uplift on their credit for emergency. Confirm amount and I will notify customer.

kevin_network: For safety, we should both tether and add a tenant isolation rule so the extra tokens don't affect other tenants. Proposed: temporary QPS to 240 -> 480 (2x) for 30m, with isolation true (dedicated slice flagged). Also apply more aggressive per-IP backoff to prevent replay storms.

alex_oncall: Sounds good. Maria, please run the override. Post the exact CLI/curl you run so we have audit trail. I'll watch metrics and keep the customer looped.

maria_prod_eng: Running now. Command: ```
# emergency tether + isolation
rictl quota override --tenant citrine --pool vpc-eu-west-1 \
  --qps 480 --burst 1200 --duration 30m --isolate true --note "emergency uplift 2x per request from sales approval"
```

maria_prod_eng: Sent. Control plane returned job_id=job_20241009_7321. Pushing policy update to edge nodes; propagation expected <60s.

incident-bot: job status: job_20241009_7321 -> applied to 12/12 edge nodes (propagated).

kevin_network: I also pushed an ip-level rate-limit patch to avoid repeated retries from a handful of client IPs: ```
rictl ip-policy update --pool vpc-eu-west-1 --add 'citrine:per_ip_limit=60' --note "aggressive per-ip backoff"
```

alex_oncall: Metrics check: I see error rate from citrine drop from 18% -> 4% within 90s. Latency stable. Can we hold for 30m and then revert to previous quota?

sam_sales_eng: Customer confirmed they can queue non-critical batches and stagger prod jobs; very appreciative. I'll log the contract note and follow up billing.

sre_lead: Good containment. After we revert, we should run quick postmortem: root cause appears to be an unthrottled batch that bypassed client-side retry backoff. Action items: (1) add tenant-specific canary for big QPS jumps, (2) update onboarding docs warning about batch jobs, (3) consider automated short-lived uplifts for trusted enterprise customers. I'll schedule.

alex_oncall: Copy. I'll keep watch and close thread after revert. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. :thumbsup:
